title: Spin-off／Merger Arbitrage／Deal-break Risk分拆併購套利與破局風險

ownershipBoundary.d1119Owner: tradable consideration geometry, exchange-ratio versioning, spread/break state, hedge/borrow/cost semantics, spin-off entitlement/stub semantics

officialSourceContract.name: TWSE material information clause 11
officialSourceContract.finding: Board resolutions for merger/demerger/acquisition/share exchange/conversion and later cancellation/material changes are disclosure events.

officialSourceContract.name: TWSE Operating Rules Chapter IV-1
officialSourceContract.finding: Merger/share-conversion/spin-off stages have explicit stop-trading, termination-of-listing, listing and effective-date mechanics.

officialSourceContract.name: TWSE demerger rules
officialSourceContract.finding: For qualifying listed-company demergers, independent expert opinion on exchange ratio/acquisition price and shareholder-rights impact is required; demerger and relisting/stop-trading mechanics are separately defined.

officialSourceContract.name: D11-06 material-transaction PIT contract
officialSourceContract.finding: Official Taiwan rules already establish versioned announcement/amendment/cancellation/closing clocks. D11-19 reuses these clocks and must not duplicate D11-06 alpha/event votes.

payoffGeometry.repriceRule: Use only terms first-known at t. Revised ratios/components append a new version; never rewrite the earlier deal value.
payoffGeometry.spinOffRule: Parent, distributed child, retained stake and stub are distinct instruments/claims. If child tradability or entitlement is not proven, value is UNKNOWN.

falsification: announced consideration is not timeless; 2887/2888 terms changed materially before closing
deal spread is not expected return without success probability, time, funding, tax, fees, hedge/borrow and break-loss assumptions
original merger cancellation can lead to a different transaction structure rather than company-level deal abandonment
a cancellation state is real even when the counterparty is not publicly tradable
spin-off approval does not imply distributed/listed child shares
acquirer and target cannot inherit one common sign
multiple disclosures from one deal are correlated versions, not independent event observations
costAndExecutionRequirements: borrow availability and recall for stock consideration
odd-lot/fractional-share and preferred-security treatment when relevant
pitRules: Use capturedAt as conservative replay availability unless native availability is authenticated.
Append every terms revision, approval, cancellation and close version.
Do not backfill final exchange ratio, preferred component or closing state to original announcement.
If child/stub tradability or hedge/borrow status is not source-verified, keep UNKNOWN.

limitations: no transaction-cost or spread-return outcome cohort opened
no listed-child spin-off arbitrage sample yet
some cancellation/structure-change witnesses rely on MOPS transports rather than immutable native payload archives

exactNext: Archive native immutable MOPS versions for one repriced stock deal and one public-target break/termination; add a listed-child or entitlement-bearing spin-off case if available; only then preregister identical-parent spread, hedge, borrow, cost and break-loss outcomes for L4.
